name: data-object-rejections
description: Malformed data objects the receiver either discards without telling anyone, or renders wrong. Ragged parallel arrays are the dangerous case: nothing errors, and the chart simply plots the wrong thing.

rejects.reason: An unrecognised type is discarded server-side with only a console warning; the client sees success.
The internal type is reserved for NetCrunch's own sensors.
The id is the object's identity across payloads and must not be empty.
A table requires both columns and rows.
Every row must have as many cells as there are columns; the receiver renders the mismatch rather than reporting it.
timestamps and values must be the same length.
categories and values must be the same length.
